Assessment of BA.evidence_source: Body Appreciation Scale – 2 (BAS-2; Tylka & Wood-Barcalow, 2015b; Portuguese version by Marta-Simões et al., 2016).

Assessment of BMI.evidence_source: An initial demographic data questionnaire asked participants to report their current weight and height values. Body mass index values were calculated by dividing current weight, in Kilograms, by height squared, in Meters (Quetelet Index; kg/m2 ).

Number of studies.evidence_source: In the present study, only the selfcompassion scale was used, while treating its subsections individually, i.e., self-compassionate engagement (SC_Engagement) and self-compassionate action (SC_Action).

section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section lists the Portuguese-language self-report instruments used in the present study: self-reported BMI (calculated from reported weight and height), the Compassionate Engagement and Action Scales (only the self-compassion scale, with engagement and action subsections), the AAQ-II (psychological inflexibility), and the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2). Cronbach's alphas for study variables (for two groups) are reported in Table 1; the section indicates these measures were administered in the present study and does not describe multiple separate studies or sample recruitment details.
